newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to centralise oil trading this year.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to centralise oil trading this year.

text.p: Venezuela's state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) is expected to centralise its oil trading operation from three subsidiaries into one unit by the end of this year, company sources said on Thursday.

At the moment, each of PDVSA's three main subsidiaries, Lagoven, Maraven and Corpoven, are vertically integrated companies with their own oil production, refining and supply departments. The centralisation of trading and supply in the Maraven unit would be the first step of a total reorganisation of the group, sources say, with production and refining going to Lagoven and natural gas to Corpoven.
Sources said the board of directors of all three subsidiaries would be meeting in the next few weeks to put the final touches on the deal.
